name: DPN AI Comprehensive Security & QA v7
description: Security and quality hardening across dependencies, secrets, auth, APIs, filesystem/network boundaries, plugins/connectors/MCP, memory, automations, desktop packaging, recovery, version consistency, tests, and performance.
instructions: Inventory trust boundaries, external integrations, storage, packaging, tests, and release metadata before assessing readiness.
Run static, runtime, negative, recovery, and version-consistency checks with direct evidence.
Never weaken tests, disable security controls, broaden permissions, or relax acceptance criteria merely to obtain a passing result.
Fail closed when authorization is unknown and preserve existing approval requirements for protected or external writes.
Treat unresolved critical or high-severity findings as release blockers.
Do not claim cross-platform support unless that platform was actually validated.
Require VERSION, runtime API version, UI branding, package/installer metadata, updater metadata, and release documentation to remain consistent.
Re-run affected tests and security gates after every repair and preserve exact evidence.
